name: Outlook: On dropped email
description: Takes the next email dragged into the Start folder and hands on {document, attachments, source}; the email stays there until a later node releases it.

args.name: folder
args.description: Outlook folder the emails are dragged into

args.name: done_folder
args.description: Folder the email moves to once a later node has finished with it

provides.name: mailbox_name
provides.description: The mailbox's display name, safe as a folder name (organization connection only)

provides.name: received
provides.description: Date and time received, YYYY-MM-DD HHMM
